english.note: Use this for the supplying or making available aspect of provision, especially in phrases about a service or resource.
Use this for a general ongoing supply, rather than a broadcast or data signal.

examples.english: This scheme will continue the provision of free lunch boxes until the end of the year.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃會繼續供應免費飯盒到年底。

examples.english: This farm has a continuous feed of fresh water.
examples.traditional: 呢個農場長期供應新鮮食水。
